claim: Kirron Kher, BJP’s Chandigarh MP, said “Rape is part of Indian culture and tradition. We cannot stop it!”

sub_claims.question: Is Kirron Kher a BJP Member of Parliament from Chandigarh?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, Kirron Kher is a BJP MP from Chandigarh, first elected in 2014 and re-elected in 2019.

evidence.statement: Kirron Kher was elected as a Member of Parliament from Chandigarh in the 2014 Indian general elections representing the Bharatiya Janata Party.
Kirron Kher was re-elected as a Member of Parliament from Chandigarh in the 2019 Indian general elections representing the Bharatiya Janata Party.
